pages.title: Blowout!
pages.text: When worn-out skates fall apart in the middle of a race in Skitchin', that's a blowout. It ends your race, and Blowout! plays.

pages.title: Gear that wears out
pages.text: Six pieces of your gear wear out as you race: skates, wheels, knee pads, elbow pads, wrist guards and gloves. Each comes in five grades, from Economy, Beginner and Standard up to Quality and Professional.

pages.title: Face Plant, the snow version
pages.text: EA also planned a snow version of Skitchin' called Face Plant, a kind of Road Rash on skis and snowboards, with 15 rivals and a no-rules mode called Free Ride. The magazine Sega Zone put it on a cover in December 1993, but it was quietly canceled.
